Name: Maoch
Role: King of Gath; Father of Achish
Summary: Maoch was king of Gath before his son Achish, in whose reign David twice sought refuge among the Philistines.
KeyStory: Maoch's son inherited a throne that would shelter Israel's future king.
RelatedPeople: Achish, Son of Maoch; King David
LifeLesson: A father's throne can become, unknowingly, a refuge for God's purposes.
